name: Sunshine Joiner

items.why: The item says no foreign-government, FARA, state-owned-business or foreign-agent-donor ties were documented, so there is no conduct to weigh under foreign ties (criterion 2).

for_review: Item 1 was a 'none documented' placeholder, not an accusation. I ran three searches. They found no controversy, ethics complaint, or foreign-tie reporting about Joiner. Results were only election coverage (Joiner won re-election on Nov 3, 2026 with 54.1%), city pages, and meeting minutes. The owner-site search (Alex Jones/Infowars/Stew Peters) returned nothing about her. I did not open FARA, Florida Commission on Ethics, or campaign-finance databases directly, so a person could check those. I did not look into her work history beyond her campaign site (hospitality director and pastor at Bayside Community Church, musician). Her elected office is real work for criterion 4.
